name: Creamy Garlic Chicken with Spinach and Bacon Skillet
ingredients_verbatim: 6 chicken thighs, boneless and skin off (or chicken breast)
1/3 cup chicken broth (or dry white wine)
1 teaspoon cornstarch (cornflour) mixed with 1 tablespoon of water (optional, if you like a thicker sauce)
unmapped: half and half (board may track heavy cream/milk instead)
why: One-pan chicken saute in a garlic/half-and-half cream sauce with crispy bacon, spinach and parmesan; no starch base, structurally low-carb. NOTE: source page publishes NO per-serving nutrition, so src_cal/src_carbs here are a STRUCTURAL ESTIMATE (chicken + butter + bacon + half-and-half + parmesan over 6 servings ~= 520-560 cal, ~7g carbs) - it qualifies under the no-nutrition-but-structurally-low-carb rule, not on verified numbers. Bacon distinguishes it from catalog chicken-florentine (which is the same cream+spinach base). Chicken thighs/breast, olive oil, butter, garlic, onion, bacon, parmesan, spinach all map; half-and-half is the only ingredient needing a board decision. Scales to 14 by weigh-and-divide.
confidence: low on nutrition - NO published macros, values estimated from structure; high on ingredient list (read from source). Dedup risk vs chicken-florentine mitigated by bacon.
